 Chills and holiday thrills at Holy Cross High School
 By Michael Gannon 
 … Comments 
 Posted on November 18, 2026 
 Holy Cross HIgh School is hosting showings of the play “Frankenstein” on Dec. 4 and 5; and running its Holiday Fair on Dec. 12. Photo by Michael Gannon 
 Search our comprehensive guide to things to do in Queens for more local events — or submit your own ! 
 The Holy Cross High School Parents Association in Flushing is inviting members of the public to two events coming up next month.
 The school is hosting productions of the play “Frankenstein” at 7 p.m. on Friday, Dec. 4, and 2 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 5, at 26-20 Francis Lewis Blvd.
 The play is based on the 1818 Gothic novel by Mary Shelley.
 Tickets will be available at the door and are $15 for premium seating or $10 for general admission.
 The Holy Cross High School Holiday Fair is scheduled for 11 a.m. to 4 p.m. on Saturday, Dec. 12. The day will include holiday shopping opportunities, vendors, activities, raffles and more.
 The school may be reached at (718) 886-7250 for further information and is online at holycrosshs.org.
